title: Genomic DNA Extraction from Wahlenbergia Leaves
author: Diep R R Ganguly
materials: Allow samples to cool to room temperature.

steps.title: Grind plant material
steps.instruction: Ensure leaf tissue is ground to a fine powder using a mortar and pestle or TissueLyser, keeping the material frozen throughout the process.

steps.title: Prepare CTAB lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Prepare lysis buffer containing 2 % (w/v) CTAB, 2 M NaCl, 100 mM Tris‑Cl pH 8, 20 mM EDTA pH 8, and 1 % (w/v) PVP‑40; keep the buffer warm (~60 °C) before use.

steps.title: Aliquot lysis buffer and add additives
steps.instruction: Aliquot 550 µL lysis buffer per sample, then add 0.5 % (v/v) 2‑mercaptoethanol, 100–200 µg/mL RNase A, and optionally 50 µM spermidine or spermine.

steps.title: Add warmed lysis buffer to tissue
steps.instruction: Add 500–1,000 µL warmed lysis buffer to the frozen, ground tissue (≈500 µL per 50 mg tissue).

steps.title: Vortex tissue suspension
steps.instruction: Mix vigorously for 10–15 seconds until all plant material is fully in solution.

steps.title: Incubate at 60 °C
steps.instruction: Incubate the suspension at 60 °C for 1–3 hours, mixing gently every 20–30 minutes (or using a tube rotator/ThermoMixer).

steps.title: Add chloroform:IAA
steps.instruction: Add an equal volume of chloroform:IAA (24:1) to each tube and mix thoroughly for 10–15 seconds.

steps.title: First centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge samples for 10 minutes at 20,000 rcf.

steps.title: Add sodium acetate
steps.instruction: Add 0.1 volume of 3 M sodium acetate (pH 5.2) to the supernatant.

steps.title: Second centrifugation
steps.instruction: Centrifuge for 20 minutes at 20,000 rcf.

steps.title: Transfer aqueous phase
steps.instruction: Transfer the upper aqueous phase (~400 µL) to a clean tube.

steps.title: Repeat chloroform extraction
steps.instruction: Perform a second chloroform extraction on the recovered aqueous phase (≈300 µL).

substeps.instruction: Add an equal volume of chloroform:IAA (24:1) and mix 10–15 seconds.
Add 0.1 volume of 3 M sodium acetate (pH 5.2).

steps.title: Precipitate DNA with ethanol
steps.instruction: Add 750 µL of 70 % ethanol, invert to mix, then incubate 30–60 minutes at room temperature (or 1–12 hours at –20 °C if using ethanol).

steps.title: Pellet DNA
steps.instruction: Centrifuge samples at 9,200 rcf for 10 minutes.

steps.title: Discard supernatant
steps.instruction: Carefully discard the supernatant without disturbing the pellet.

steps.title: Remove residual ethanol
steps.instruction: Pipette off as much ethanol as possible, then air‑dry the pellet for 2–3 minutes.

steps.title: Add isopropanol
steps.instruction: Add 1 volume of 2‑propanol (or, if volume permits, 3 volumes of ethanol) to the dried pellet.

steps.title: Mix and incubate
steps.instruction: Mix by gentle inversion and incubate for 3 minutes at room temperature.

steps.title: Warm lysis buffer
steps.instruction: Warm lysis buffer to 60 °C, add to the pellet, and mix by gentle inversion to re‑dissolve any precipitates.

steps.title: Incubate at 50 °C
steps.instruction: If DNA remains insoluble, incubate at 50 °C to aid dissolution.

steps.title: Resuspend DNA
steps.instruction: Resuspend the DNA pellet in nuclease‑free water or 10 mM Tris‑Cl pH 8.

steps.title: Assess DNA quality
steps.instruction: Determine DNA yield, purity, and size distribution using a Nanodrop spectrophotometer and gel or capillary electrophoresis.
